messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync 1: NovaCorp dedicated pool bring-up tomorrow 09:00 PDT. Need final sign-off on quotas, autoscale policy, and load run plan. @raj_infra @leo_sre @anya_ops please confirm.

maria_cs: Checklist: 1) Reserve pool 2) Soft quota during shadow 3) Hard quota post-validation 4) 15m shadow @65% then 7m smoke @100% 5) Tag runs `novacorp-renew-2026` and export metrics.

raj_infra: Reserving pool now. Propose soft_concurrent=1500, hard=2200 with 10m temporary burst to 2500.

leo_sre: Agree to soft cap. Autoscale: min_instances=2, max_instances=28, cooldown=70s, target_p95=310ms. Fallback model set to quant-small, trigger if p95 > 800ms for 2 minutes.

anya_ops: Product and renewals teams want p95, error rate, cost per 1k tokens, fallback_count, cache_hit_ratio. Tag runs for CSV.

maria_cs: Can someone paste k6 command to include in runbook?

leo_sre: ```
# shadow (15m @65%)
k6 run --vus 130 --duration 15m loadtests/novacorp-shadow.js \\  --env TARGET=https://staging-api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \\  --tag run=novacorp-shadow-65 --tag phase=shadow --header "X-Shadow-Account: novacorp" --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086

# smoke (7m @100%)
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 7m loadtests/novacorp-smoke.js \\  --env TARGET=https://staging-api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \\  --tag run=novacorp-smoke-100 --tag phase=smoke --header "X-Shadow-Account: novacorp" --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086
```

maria_cs: Thanks. Pre-run huddle 08:30 PDT. Deploy-bot, please report when pool is ready.

deploy-bot: reserved pool created (id: rp-10021). Autoscale policy `novacorp-dedicated-v1` attached.

raj_infra: rp-10021 live. I'll keep hard quota disabled until 15m after shadow. Enabling soft throttles during shadow.

leo_sre: Oncall window: leo_sre primary, raj_infra backup. Increasing trace retention to 14d for this run. Rollback rule: if error_rate > 1.2% AND p95 > 700ms for 3 windows, fallback and scale to floor.

anya_ops: I'll collect enablement feedback and include survey link in post-run notes.

maria_cs: Summary: rp-10021, policy novacorp-dedicated-v1, shadow 15m@65% -> smoke 7m@100%, pre-run 08:30 PDT, oncall leo/raj, tag novacorp-renew-2026. I'll post CSV and brief notes after. Good luck. :thumbsup:

leo_sre: See you tomorrow.

(End of thread)
